sourceWitness.inventory: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard -- *.rs *.toml *.lock; unique ordinal path order
sourceWitness.encoding: UTF-8 concatenated relative path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + LF

checks.command: cargo +stable test -p claw-state -p claw-channels -p gta-claw-daemon -p gta-claw-tui --all-targets --locked --quiet
cargo +stable clippy -p claw-state -p claw-channels -p gta-claw-daemon -p gta-claw-tui --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings

unverified: durable provider cursor or Discord resume session
operator-approved replay workflow for dormant queued inputs
